chapter_note: Chapter has heavy lacunae (73% damage). Structure: chapter title (0-2) + dialogue frame (3) + numbered enumeration of four worldly matters that drive humans to kill each other (4-17: food/mouth, fornication, wealth, war) + summary description (18-20) + speaker pivot (21) + cosmological contrast: separation of Light from Darkness through Mani's revelation (22-26) + closing contrast about those who pursue worldly matters (27-29). The enumerated four-fold teaching of worldly vices is structurally substratic (systematic numbered impersonal categorical mapping), and the dualistic Light/Darkness separation passage is core cosmological teaching. Final segments shift to hortatory closure.
